title: Freeing a VisualInstance3D takes seconds while many newly added mesh instances are pending (grows ~quadratically)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Windows 11 Pro (26300) - Godot v4.7.2.stable - Vulkan 1.4.351 - Forward+ - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X (also reproduces with Mobile and Compatibility)

### Issue description

Freeing a `VisualInstance3D` while many newly added mesh instances are still pending (no frame has been drawn since they were added) takes seconds, and the time grows roughly quadratically with the number of pending instances. Here it is a single `MeshInstance3D.new().free()` that was never added to the tree. Once a frame has been drawn, the same free takes well under 0.1 ms, and the frames that absorb the same pending work take a small fraction of the time.

One `free()` after adding N `MeshInstance3D` (shared `BoxMesh`) in the same frame:

| N pending | one free() | same free after drawing 2 frames | those 2 frames |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5,000 | 97 ms | | |
| 10,000 | 365 ms | | |
| 20,000 | 1,491 ms | 0.0 ms | 48 ms |
| 50,000 | 9,226 ms | 0.0 ms | 189 ms |

What changes it (N = 20,000):

- Pending instances without a mesh (`mesh = null`): 1.3 ms. With a mesh each (`BoxMesh.new()` per instance, not shared): still 1,562 ms, so it is not about one shared mesh (compare #69874).
- Freeing a plain `Node3D` instead of a `MeshInstance3D`: 0.0 ms.
- `--headless`: 6 ms.
- `--rendering-method mobile`: 1,473 ms; `gl_compatibility`: 1,521 ms.

Workaround: let a frame draw after adding many instances before freeing any visual node.

### Steps to reproduce

1. New project, main scene a `Node3D` with the script below.
2. Run with `-- --count=50000`: prints about 9 s for one free.
3. Run with `-- --count=50000 --draw-first`: prints 0.0 ms.

```gdscript
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var count := 50000
	var draw_first := false
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--count="):
			count = arg.trim_prefix("--count=").to_int()
		elif arg == "--draw-first":
			draw_first = true
	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	for i in count:
		var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
		instance.mesh = box
		instance.position = Vector3(i % 300, 0, i / 300)
		add_child(instance)
	if draw_first:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await get_tree().process_frame
	var lone := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var started := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	lone.free()
	print("count=%d draw_first=%s: one free took %.1f ms" % [count, draw_first, (Time.get_ticks_usec() - started) / 1000.0])
	get_tree().quit()
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The script above is the whole project (a `Node3D` main scene with it attached, default project settings).
